system.description:
Disguise is the art of changing one’s face or appearance to look like another person or ethnicity.

Obstacles: Disguise gender, Ob 1. Disguise social class: City dweller, Ob 1; Merchant or priest, Ob 2. Peasant, Ob 3. Noble or wizard, Ob 4. Disguise stock: Human/Orc, Ob 2; Dwarf/Human, Orc/Troll, Orc/Roden, Ob 3; Roden/Human, Elf/Human, Ob 4; Dwarf/Roden/Troll, Ob 5. Elf/Roden/Troll, Ob 6. Orc/Elf, Ob 7. Roden/Wolf, Ob 8. Other/Wolf, Ob 9. Any/Spider, Ob 10.

FoRKs: Acting, Theatrics

Skill Type: Special. Tools: Yes. Expendable.

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 267
